snippet.textDisplay:
A big reason why Georgia blew out their last 2 opponents was vs a rival and the team that ended their season. Thats pretty easy to get up for. I wonder how they’ll do vs a team they have no motivation for? Georgia has ZERO chip on their shoulders in this game.  

Unfortunately I expect the players to get complacent again and the turnover demon to come back. That being said, I also expect Georgia to win. However, Mizzou is an extremely talented team that’s fully capable of beating them if they’re not careful.

snippet.textDisplay:
As a Mizzou fan, I say it is guaranteed that Georgia will win. They should be looking forward to the playoffs and not even be concerned about Missouri. Its a done deal. All the pundits agree. It is like a race between a tortoise and a hare. Georgia is so good, and Missouri will probably not even show up. The coach of the Bulldogs is smart, and the coach of the tigers has the wits of a drinker! It will go just like the rest of the college football season has gone...predictably. 

What a minute!

snippet.textDisplay: I disagree. I don’t think Auburn did it. I think UGA did it to themselves! The thing about the SEC is humility is only a week away if you’re not ready if you’re not prepared if you’re overconfident, you might get your ass kicked by away less talented team.
